scope: Standalone RequestRetentions component and additive legacy HttpExchange retainRequest default only; core/adapter integration excluded
assessment: Frozen helper API and constructor/null checks distinguish the requested reusable component from an ad-hoc transport implementation. Zero initial count and no initial callback, independent counts, two-hold last-release transition and repeated-release idempotence provide direct positive/negative controls.

New cycles and stale release tests prevent an old release from consuming current ownership. Concurrent duplicate releases exercise once-state races; concurrent retain/release under a sentinel checks both no premature zero callback and preserved final ownership, followed by exact last-transition count.

Callbacks observe completed zero state, can reenter retain/release and can join a second subscriber thread outside internal locks. A blocked old callback permits a new retention that remains held after old callback exit, guarding against post-callback count reset.

RuntimeException and Error callbacks are explicitly fail-soft without poisoning later cycles. Assertions for callback observations/failures are made after callbacks return, avoiding swallowed assertion false positives. Threads/futures have bounded waits and executor shutdown joins.

Legacy Wave3Exchange remains unchanged and throws AssertionError on transport methods. Default SPI reflection requires inherited default Runnable retainRequest with no arguments/checked exceptions; repeated release actions must be harmless while old abstract SPI inventories remain exact.
Preserved RED evidence shows13 missing-helper failures plus2 missing-SPI/inventory failures and16 baseline controls passing, with zero errors/skips. Only two test files changed.
limitations: Successful helper/default tests cannot establish actual POST response-before-first-body-read safety. Core retain/release wiring, adapter input/context retention, abort and shutdown integration require separate actual integration tests under AC-8.
actions: No repository edits or builds; only tmp report written. Stop at first PASS.
